messages:
maria: Quick sync  We're coordinating a base image rebuild + keystore rotation across runtime fleets next week. Need final sign-offs on RBAC deltas, audit sinks, and a rollback plan.
alex: Which images are being rebuilt? any breaking lib changes we need to flag to runtime teams?
maria: Targets: base-runtime:1.22 -> base-runtime:1.23 (glibc minor), slim-bake:2026-03, and gpu-base:stable-2026. Rebuild includes seccomp profile tighten + drop CAP_NET_RAW. No incompatible syscall removals expected but we should run e2e canaries.
sam: For keystore: plan is to rotate cosign key and KMS wrapping key (cloud-kms HSM). Important: attestation verifier service needs access to both old and new keys during handover.
ops-bot: notice: previous keystore rotation attempt failed on staging due to missing iam:Sign on serviceAccount:attest-verifier@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
jen: Let's avoid that. I can prepare an RBAC patch that scopes Sign permission to the attestation SA and restricts key use to specific cryptoKeyVersions.
maria: Good. Also add audit export so we can pull AsymmetricSign/Verify and key usage logs into the forensic bucket: gs://audit-longterm/keystore-rotations. We need 90 days retention for these events.
alex: On runtime side we should pre-warm KV caches and update node imagePullSecrets rotation TTL to 2h to avoid bursts. If pull creds rotate while node is evicting, we could see transient pull failures.
sam: Suggestion: do zero-downtime image pull using blue/green: create new image tag with build-id and update deploys with maxUnavailable=0 for canary nodes.
jen: I'll own the RBAC PR: patch will include `resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign` `role: roles/cloudkms.signer` and `members: [\"serviceAccount:attest-verifier@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"]` plus a small exception for `group:rebuild-ops@redwood.com` to trigger canary pushes.
ops-bot: policy-check: RBAC diff attached, recommends adding condition restricting request.time < key.deprecationTime for old keys.
maria: Nice. Can we also enable CMEK audit logs to include protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp? incident team asked for source IP in case of suspicious signing events.
alex: We'll need SRE to whitelist logging queries, and add a short alert: more than 3 failed AsymmetricSign errors in 5m => auto-pause rollout.
sam: For vulnerability triage: rebuilt images will include updated libssl and libcurl. Security team will run internal SBOM diff and a fast scan; if any critical CVEs appear we abort. Add a preflight script: `./tools/preflight-checks.sh --sbom-diff --seccomp-validate`.
jen: On rollback plan: keep previous cosign key ENABLED and set label \"deprecated\" on new key if issues found. Rollback steps note: 1) set deployment annotation to previous image tag 2) re-run `cosign verify` against old key 3) revoke new key use by deleting signing binding.\alm: (typo: please ignore)
ops-bot: deploy-window: proposed canary Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC, prod wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Approvals required from: eng-sre, eng-runtime, eng-security.
maria: Approve timings. One more ask: telemetry team, can you add a short logpipe to capture cosign Verify/Sign latency so we can correlate failures to KMS latency spikes?
alex: I'll add a Prometheus exporter to the attestation service to emit `cosign_sign_latency_ms`. Also add a Grafana dashboard panel.
sam: During canary we'll run smoke assertions: `- verify attestation signature for canary-image` `- curl health endpoints` `- check audit logs for matching AsymmetricSign entries within 30s`. Provide gcloud query for ops: `gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign AND resource.labels.crypto_key_id:cosign\" --limit 5`
jen: I'll include a quickpost in the PR with the exact query and sample expected log JSON to make oncall triage faster.
ops-bot: alert: create monitor \"keystore-rotation-fails\" threshold 3 errors / 5m, notify @sre-oncall.
maria: Thanks everyone. Owners: jen -> RBAC PR, alex -> runtime preflight + metrics, sam -> keystore rotation scripts + canary orchestration. I'll assemble the runbook and ping eng-sre for the window.
jen: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/p/rbac/patches/88. Adding reviewers: @maria @alex @sam @eng-sre.
maria: End state: rebuilds succeed on canary, audit logs show sign events, no vuln regressions, and rollback tested. If any blocker shows up during canary we abort and escalate to incident channel.
